filtersOrSort: by id from ?id= in address; status must be draft or sealed (other statuses redirect to /app/wishes/<id>, removed or unknown shows the missing state); also reads all account wishes to find an untouched draft to reuse (untouched: status draft, step 0, no name/call/opensAt/photos/words)
reads.note: Held today inside the 'fw-account' localStorage Account object (Account.wishes[]). WishContent sub-fields: letter, reasons, memory, story, voices, note, blessing, timeline, details, credits, links, studio, partner, gift, finale, off, on, opening, ending, cover
localStorage 'fw-maker', per wish id; wedding day and 'opens now' and voice seconds have no place on Wish; given/chosen record whether the opening link named kind/occasion
signed-in person; name is used as Wish.from default, pro.business as default studio

static lib/engine/registry.ts and lib/occasions.ts; screen shown only when more than one opening is allowed or the opening has non-date/time fields. Fields shown on this screen exclude date and time (those are set at seal).

payload.name: content.opening.values
payload.type: Record<string,string> reset to {} when switching, kept when re-tapping

payload.name: content.opening.values
payload.type: Record<string,string> e.g. code, hint, question, answer (passcode and question openings)

actions.name: saveDraft

payload.name: wish
payload.type: full Wish object (spread of previous plus patch)

actions.note: saveWish(w) writes the whole Wish into Account.wishes on every change, debounced 300ms for typing, immediate for choices, plus on pagehide/visibilitychange/unmount. Returns false when browser storage is full (then the 'Not saved: no room left' notice shows and the change is rolled back for immediate saves). Also each step change writes Wish.step.

authContext.note: The maker renders blank (aria-busy) until an Account is read; there is no redirect to sign in coded in these files (app/app/new layout/page are 8 and 10 lines; not read beyond the scan map). Business wishes (account.pro and spaceOf==business, or kind teams/photographers) count on a plan.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: account === undefined/null (useAccount) or wish/screen/play not yet set: renders <div class='fm' aria-busy>
uiStatesHandled.note: Account read from localStorage synchronously in an effect; blank for one frame. After wiring to a server it becomes a real fetch of the draft.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: ?id= given and no wish with that id and status != removed in the account (Maker.tsx:89-90)
uiStatesHandled.note: 'That wish is not here' with Start a new wish link. Reachable on another device because drafts are device-local; after wiring, also for a wish owned by someone else or deleted.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: saveWish returns false (localStorage quota) -> header says 'Not saved: no room left' (Maker.tsx:439)
uiStatesHandled.note: Disappears once the server is the store; replaced by a save failure.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: allowed openings length 1: no radio list, hint 'This occasion opens one way.'

stubsObserved.evidence: saveWish writes the draft into localStorage 'fw-account'; the maker reads the draft from useAccount() (localStorage)
stubsObserved.standsInFor: a server-held draft Wish saved on every step
stubsObserved.consequence: drafts exist only on one device; ?id= from another device shows 'not here'

stubsObserved.standsInFor: server-held draft state (given/chosen flags, wedding day, opens-now, voice seconds)
stubsObserved.consequence: these fields have no place on the Wish; a server must store them or the Wish model must grow

stubsObserved.evidence: id: uid() = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8) client-side; wishNo random four digits (maker.ts:449)
stubsObserved.standsInFor: server-issued id (UUIDv7) and wish number issued in order

stubsObserved.evidence: the passcode or answer is typed in plain text into content.opening.values (code, answer)
stubsObserved.standsInFor: a secret the server stores hashed and checks; the phone's clock and client never trusted (conventions)
stubsObserved.consequence: the secret sits in the draft in clear; server must hash on ingest and never return it to a receiver

note: Opening choice lives at Wish.content.opening {id, values, scene?}; opening day/time (values.at, values.time, values.to) are set on the seal screen (not this one). Sealed-until time is stored as ISO opensAt today, no IANA zone yet.
